rawContent: We ain’t canceling nobody. The only thing been canceled in the last few years is #BlackLivesMatter. The rest of the B.S. has eternal life.

When I started Twitter it was a space where I could vent about the untimely death of Trayvon Martin & Mike Brown. Since then the #BlackLivesMatter movement has been overshadowed by Memes, GIFs & IG Stories. You have to wonder who presents us with these distractions & why?

#BlackLivesMatter lasted about six months. We ain’t bout ish. Black celebrities never bought into a cause that championed the average Joe’s being gunned down. Somehow that negatively affects their branding. The police didn’t stop killing us we just stop talking about it.
Yeah nice story but please stop killing & brutalizing people of color. #BlackLivesMatter
It’s interesting how the slogan #BlackLivesMatter was deemed so offensive. Like our lives mattering is somehow an affront to the majority race. White media can make anything negative.
